finding: Cross-functional commercial/cost role spans estimating, procurement, finance and project control.
Pre-contract estimating role requires dedicated work-product composition across F07/F09.
Current generated architecture splits one employable job across initiation, execution and closure profiles.
Construction Project Manager is a partial base but site execution work products span project, field, QHSE, logistics and information.
No direct sector Job Profile exists in the generated function-derived baseline.
Existing Architect titles are IT/enterprise architecture roles, not built-environment architectural practice.
No direct professional MEP/building-services Job Profile exists.
No direct professional building-surveying Job Profile exists.
F22 Facilities Manager is useful but requires explicit asset, maintenance, compliance, contractor, budget and service work products.
Employable procurement management role composes strategy, sourcing, contracting, supplier and operational work.
Construction contract administration spans sales/commercial negotiation, legal contract management and controlled contract records.
Generated Project Planner is a useful direct base but requires explicit WBS, schedule, baseline, progress and delay work products.
Generated Project Controls Manager is a useful base but must compose finance, risk, change and reporting work products outside F27.
No single Project Accountant profile; the employment job composes cost accounting, close, reporting and project financial-control context.
No built-environment Design Manager employment profile exists; the role spans information requirements, planning, review, coordination, change and handover.
No direct built-environment Civil Engineer Job Profile exists.
No direct built-environment Structural Engineer Job Profile exists.
No direct regulatory Building Control Officer Job Profile exists.
The employable H&S management role composes framework, risk, inspection, permit and incident responsibilities.
Quality management spans planning, assurance, inspection, NCR/defect, CAPA, supplier quality and reporting.
Environmental management requires both operational environmental control and compliance/return responsibilities.
Asset management spans strategy, information, criticality/condition, investment, maintenance and disposal.
Maintenance planning requires preventive planning plus reactive/backlog and resource/parts coordination.
No direct trade Electrician Job Profile exists despite the role requiring estimate, field execution, testing, certification, asset and maintenance work.
No direct trade Plumber Job Profile exists despite end-to-end survey, quote, installation, testing, asset and service work.
No direct plant-operator Job Profile exists; the role requires mobile allocation, checks, utilisation, defects, progress and safety evidence.
